description: This file implements a JSON parser class with methods for parsing JSON strings, handling escape sequences, nested structures, and errors. It includes internal classes and functions for managing parsing state and Unicode decoding.

classes.name: StackMarker
classes.description: A utility class to check for maximum recursion depth during JSON parsing.

classes.name: JSONParser
classes.description: Main class responsible for parsing JSON strings into Value objects, handling syntax, escape sequences, nested structures, and errors.

classes.name: JSONParser::StringBuilder
classes.description: Helper class for efficiently building JSON strings during parsing, handling Unicode characters and escape sequences.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a JSON string view into a Value object, handling BOM and end-of-input validation.

methods.name: error_code
methods.description: Returns the last parse error code.

methods.name: GetErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns a formatted error message with line and column info.

methods.name: error_line
methods.description: Returns the line number where the last error occurred.

methods.name: error_column
methods.description: Returns the column number where the last error occurred.
